summary: Frontend-only testing of the new SKY-only feature: (A) ADMIN Commesse offerta servizi_attivi flow, (B) Client Create with sky_servizi, (C) Client View with sky_servizi chips, (D) Client Edit sky_servizi. All ADMIN Commesse checkpoints and Create+View checkpoints PASS. Edit flow has a CRITICAL data-loss bug: EditClienteModal does NOT initialize formData.sky_servizi from cliente.sky_servizi, so previously-selected SKY services are always shown UNCHECKED and are overwritten on save.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL DATA LOSS: The initial useState formData object (starting line 252) does NOT include a `sky_servizi` field. Therefore, when opening the Edit modal for an existing client that has cliente.sky_servizi=['TLS','NEGOZI'], the '📺 Servizi SKY' section (data-testid=edit-cliente-sky-servizi-section) renders correctly but ALL checkboxes appear UNCHECKED (because `formData.sky_servizi` is undefined, so `(formData.sky_servizi || []).includes(sid)` returns false for every id). If the operator saves — even without touching those checkboxes — any newly-toggled subset overwrites the persisted value (verified end-to-end: created client with TLS+NEGOZI; opened Edit modal → all 3 unchecked; toggled only PRESIDI + saved; re-opened View modal → shows only PRESIDI, TLS+NEGOZI were wiped).
ui_bugs.fix_hint: Add `sky_servizi: cliente?.sky_servizi || [],` to the initial formData object in EditClienteModal.jsx (around lines 252-270, next to tipologia_abitazione/indirizzo fields).

issues: Chips have no separator/whitespace between names — text content shows 'TLSNEGOZI' concatenated. Visually spacing looks fine (flex gap-1) but text_content() concatenates. Non-blocking, purely a11y/text-copy nuance.

action_items: FIX EditClienteModal.jsx initial formData: add `sky_servizi: cliente?.sky_servizi || []` alongside other cliente-derived fields (line ~265). Without this fix, editing any SKY client silently deletes previously-selected sky_servizi.

Consider adding data-testid to Save button in EditClienteModal ('edit-cliente-submit-btn') and CreateClienteModal ('create-cliente-submit-btn') for reliable automation (kept generic 'Aggiorna Cliente'/'Crea Cliente' text works but is brittle).
critical_code_review_comments: EditClienteModal.jsx: missing sky_servizi in initial formData causes silent data loss on save (see ui_bugs above).

CreateClienteModal.jsx & EditClienteModal.jsx: `getEditSkyServiziAttivi()` falls back to offerta.servizi_attivi if formData.sky_servizi is empty — but this fallback is used only for RENDERING the list of ids to show. It is NOT used to pre-check the boxes (which read only from formData.sky_servizi). Confirm this is intended (the list of options can come from offerta, but the initial CHECKED state must come from the cliente).

Commesse.jsx CreateOffertaModal + EditOffertaServiziModal correctly detect SKY via commessa.nome.toLowerCase().includes('sky'). This is fragile — a rename removing 'sky' will silently disable the whole feature. Consider a dedicated `is_sky` flag on commessa.

results.client_edit_sky_prefill: FAIL - CRITICAL BUG. Edit modal opens with all 3 SKY checkboxes UNCHECKED even though cliente.sky_servizi=['TLS','NEGOZI'] (verified via View modal). formData initial state does not include sky_servizi (see EditClienteModal.jsx line 252-270). Section itself IS visible (edit-cliente-sky-servizi-section present) and checkboxes ARE rendered — only the initial checked state is wrong. Save after toggling PRESIDI wiped TLS+NEGOZI and persisted only PRESIDI (data loss).

rca of the issue: EditClienteModal.jsx defines `const [formData, setFormData] = useState({ nome: cliente?.nome || '', ..., tipologia_abitazione: cliente?.tipologia_abitazione || '', ... })` but omits `sky_servizi: cliente?.sky_servizi || []`. The Servizi SKY checkbox rendering uses `checked={(formData.sky_servizi || []).includes(sid)}` (line 1183). Since formData.sky_servizi is undefined at open, no box is checked. When operator toggles any box, the `handleSkyServizioToggle` (line 743) uses `prev.sky_servizi || []` as base — thus starting from an empty array — and setState overwrites with only the just-toggled ids. handleSubmit then spreads formData into backendData, sending sky_servizi with the reduced array, and the PUT persists it, wiping the original persisted array. Fix is one line: `sky_servizi: cliente?.sky_servizi || [],` in the initial state around line 265.
